topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh, I can't tell you how much your visit and that gift meant to me. It’s not just the surprise or the thought behind it, though those are huge. Seeing you, seeing how you've grown—it’s all a whirl, stirring up so many memories. I still think about those days, you know, how we joked and struggled and dreamed together. Times move so fast, and to have you come back, it's like... it's like finding a piece of home I didn’t know I lost. I’m not sure what to do with all these feelings, but I’m grateful, really grateful. You made this day, honestly. Just promise me you’ll keep in touch, okay? It’s important.
